# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch83-86
Reviewer pass 1 (adversarial). Read: conventions.md, runbook.md, RUNBOOK.md (Reviewer), packet, units.json, known-forms.json, novel-forms.json, and published ch. 1–82 for house renderings. No modern translations opened; Dillmann unavailable, so doubtful points are hedged with (?). Every unit was checked: grammatical labels in the notes against the form, Geʿez → `l` word by word, `l` ↔ `i`, remembered English in `i`, house consistency. `t` is untouched (verified identical to the original units.json and to the packet). Unit numbers are 0-based, as in the published ch. 82.
Counts of changes: major 0 · moderate 21 · minor 38 (total 59).

## Findings refused (left as drafted)
- unit 9 · ደወሎሙ 'their bells (?)' and ቄሮም 'Qerom (?)': already hedged; Dillmann unavailable, nothing better to offer. The word 'coming' in i ('their bells coming from Jerusalem') is a smoothing, left as harmless.
- unit 10 · ትትቀበሎ rendered 'she' in `l` but 'they' in `i`: kept; the verb is 3fs (or 2ms), the subject the (fem.) kingdom, a collective; the note says so, and `l` is meant to be literal.
- unit 10 · አርድእዋ 'disciples' (l) / 'followers (?)' (i), ዐዋዴ 'herald (?)': hedged; kept.
- unit 12 · ፀብኣ 'host' / 'in force (?)': kept as drafted, alternative parse added to the note only.
- unit 18 · ጠፍሐት, የበበት, አጽሐሰት ('spread', 'cried', 'trod'): the note says plainly these are context guesses; i hedges each. Kept.
- unit 21 · እሊአሃ 'peers (?)' and the claim that the 'mighty men of Israel' are Menelik's Israelite companions: the identification is reasonable and consistent with earlier parts; kept.
- unit 23 · present-tense ይትፌሥሑ rendered past in `i`: the note explains it as narrative present; kept.
- unit 28 · ተዓይነ ፀር 'enemy scouts (?)', በበ ሳድስ ወሳብዕ 'by sixths and sevenths (?)', ዘበሕጉ and ወመንበረ መንግሥታኒ: all hedged and the note admits the obscurity. Kept. The causative label on ያመዘብሩ is left (the stem is a quadriliteral; the form is hedged by neighbours but the label is probably right).
- `about`, `titleEn`, `part`: checked against the text; 'regalia' in the about for ch. 86 rests on ወመንበረ መንግሥታኒ and is acceptable.
- Numbers in notes (32,000; 17,700; 770; 1,000; 700) recomputed from the Ethiopic numerals: all correct.

## Flags for the glosser / pass 2 (gloss.json not yet written; not changes to units.json)
- ወሶበ is a KNOWN entry ('and when'); in unit 1 it is the place/people name Sobo (ወ- + ሶበ). Needs a `__broaden__` or the novel entry; likewise ወባቲ (known: 'by it, with it'; here 'and she has', ባቲ = በ + -ቲ), ወልዲ ('his son' — keep as known, note ለሤም ወልዲ), ወለአኩ (known: 'and I sent' 1cs; here 3mp 'and they sent', ለአኩ), ኢሎፍሊ/ወኢሎፍሊ (known as 'foreigners, Philistines'; the form with ወ is novel), ብርት (known as unconfirmed; keep hedged, cf. ch. 21–22 [bərt]), ወኢያቡሴዎን etc. are known.
- ዘእምታሕቴሃ = ዘ- + እም- + ታሕት + -ሃ; ወአዖደት from አዐወደ/ዐወደ is hedged; አስዋረ, መጋዝአ, ጋኝተ, ደወሎሙ, ዐዋዴ, ፀብኣ, ሕጽነ: general entries should carry (?) where unsure.
- ወልዳሂ: ወልድ + -ሃ + -ሂ; እሊአሃ: keep the known entry.

# Review, pass 2 — kebra-nagast-ch83-86
Reviewer pass 2 (adversarial, Dillmann unavailable, so doubtful points are hedged with (?)). Checked every gloss.json entry (158 keys, including the 5 `__broaden__` entries) against the text: lemma as dictionary form, person/gender/number/stem/suffix, meaning, numeral format, broaden format (each starts with the old known entry whole + " · "; verified by script). Every novel form is present and no extra keys. Re-read all 30 units against the text once more. `t` is untouched (verified identical, unit count unchanged); both files were edited by script.
Counts of changes: major 0 · moderate 4 · minor 16 (total 20; 11 in gloss.json, 9 in units.json).

## Changes (target · severity · what was wrong · what was done)
- እስማኤላውያን · moderate · lemma was the bare name እስማኤል, not the dictionary form of the derived word (cf. ሰማያዊ for ሰማያዊያን); 'genitive' is not a Geʿez case · done: "እስማኤል — Ishmaelites, those of Ishmael (proper name + adjective ending -ዊ, plural -ውያን; the ending that marks peoples; genitive after the construct ንጉሠ)" → "እስማኤላዊ — Ishmaelites, those of Ishmael (adjective/noun from the name እስማኤል with -ዊ, here plural -ውያን; the ending that marks peoples; dependent on the construct ንጉሠ)"
- ለአኀዊከ · moderate · lemma እኁ is not the headword; the published entry for አኀው uses አኅ; 'oblique' is not a Geʿez category · done: "እኁ — to your brothers (ለ- + plural አኀው, oblique አኀዊ- + -ከ '2ms your')" → "አኅ — to your brothers (ለ- + plural አኀው, with the stem አኀዊ- before the suffix, + -ከ '2ms your')"
- ደወሎሙ · minor · lemma ደውል does not fit the form ደወሎ- (the base is ደወል); hedged · done: "ደውል — their bells (?) (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; sense uncertain) (?)" → "ደወል — their bells (?) (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; sense uncertain) (?)"
- ምስፍና · minor · 'the form is also ምስፍና' was circular · done: "ምስፍና — Məsfəna (place name; the form is also ምስፍና 'rule, lordship', the city's name taken from it) (?)" → "ምስፍና — Məsfəna (place name), the same word as the common noun ምስፍና 'rule, lordship', from which the city's name is taken (?)"
- ክርስትያነ · minor · ክርስትያን is the singular noun, not 'plural'; hedged · done: "ክርስትያን — Christians (noun, plural ክርስትያን, construct 'Christians of')" → "ክርስትያን — Christians (noun ክርስትያን 'Christian', here collective; construct 'Christians of'; the plural form is not certain, ?)"
- ወአጽሐሰት · minor · 'causative' asserted for a verb whose root is unknown · done: "አጽሐሰ — and she trod, stamped (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative; sense from context) (?)" → "አጽሐሰ — and she trod, stamped (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect; the stem and root are uncertain, perhaps causative; sense from context) (?)"
- ወአስዋረ · minor · first-person 'unknown to me' in a glossary entry · done: "አስዋር — and aswar (ወ- + a word unknown to me, apparently a kind of animal; accusative) (?)" → "አስዋር — and aswar (ወ- + an unidentified word, apparently a kind of animal; accusative) (?)"
- ፫፼ወ፳፻ · minor · numeral entry quoted a literal gloss where the convention gives the plain English number · done: "፫፼ወ፳፻ — 32,000, spoken ሠለስቱ ትእልፊት ወዕሥራ ምእት (śälästu təʾəlfit wä-ʿəśra məʾət) 'three myriads and twenty hundred'; the spoken form is uncertain (numeral) (?)" → "፫፼ወ፳፻ — 32,000, spoken ሠለስቱ ትእልፊት ወዕሥራ ምእት (śälästu təʾəlfit wä-ʿəśra məʾət) 'thirty-two thousand' (literally three ten-thousands and twenty hundreds); the spoken form is uncertain (numeral) (?)"
- እኁ · minor · 'plural participle' mismatched the published entry for እኁዛነ · done: "እኁዝ — holders (first part of a word wrongly divided in the source; read እኁ ዛነ as እኁዛነ 'holders of', plural participle of አኀዘ 'hold')" → "እኁዝ — holders (first part of the wrongly divided እኁዛነ 'holders of'; read እኁ ዛነ as one word; see እኁዛነ: plural እኁዛን, participle of አኀዘ 'hold')"
- ዛነ · minor · consistency with the entry above · done: "እኁዝ — holders (second part of the wrongly divided እኁዛነ; ዛነ is no word by itself)" → "እኁዝ — holders (second part of the wrongly divided እኁዛነ; ዛነ is no word by itself; see እኁ)"
- ወያመዘብሩ · moderate · gloss called the causative-looking ያመ- 'unexplained' although it is exactly the ʾa-stem imperfect of a quadriliteral · done: "መዘበረ — and they ravage, plunder (ወ- + 3mp imperfect of the quadriliteral መዘበረ; the causative-looking ያመ- is unexplained) (?)" → "መዘበረ — and they ravage, plunder (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; the form ya-ʾa-mäzäbbəru is the regular ʾa-stem (causative) imperfect of the quadriliteral መዘበረ 'plunder', or the plain stem is meant) (?)"
- መንግሥታኒ · minor · 'genitive' is not a Geʿez case · done: "መንግሥት — of the kingdom, too (noun, genitive after the construct መንበረ + enclitic -ኒ 'also, too'; the -ታ- of the form is unexplained) (?)" → "መንግሥት — of the kingdom, too (noun, dependent on the construct መንበረ + enclitic -ኒ 'also, too'; the -ታ- of the form is unexplained) (?)"
- unit 0 · n · minor · the note described the derivation loosely, as if the name itself took the plural · done: "‘Ishmaelites’ is the name እስማኤል with the adjective ending -ዊ and the plural -ውያን (‘those of Ishmael’), the ending that marks peoples." → "‘Ishmaelites’ is the adjective እስማኤላዊ (the name እስማኤል with -ዊ) in the plural -ውያን (‘those of Ishmael’), the ending that marks peoples."
- unit 1 · n · minor · ላዕለ is not repeated before each name; geography stated flatly · done: "ላዕለ ‘over’ is repeated with ወ- before each people. The list is a catalogue of peoples and lands of Africa and Arabia:" → "ላዕለ ‘over’ is repeated with ወ- for the first three names (ትርብ, ቅብጥ, ኖባ); the later names ride on it. The list is a catalogue of peoples and lands, mostly of Africa (Arabia too, ?):"
- unit 3 · n · minor · all five names are in Exodus 3:8; Genesis 15 lacks the Hivites · done: "Genesis 15:19–21 and Exodus 3:8" → "Exodus 3:8, compare Genesis 15:19–21"
- unit 15 · n · minor · -ታ is the 3fs ending -ት plus the suffix -ኣ, not a suffix by itself · done: "ዘለሊሃ አሕነጸታ ‘which she herself built it’ (አሕነጸ, the causative of ሐነጸ ‘build’; ለሊሃ ‘herself’, -ታ ‘it’, f.)." → "ዘለሊሃ አሕነጸታ ‘which she herself built it’ (አሕነጸት, 3fs perfect of the causative አሕነጸ of ሐነጸ ‘build’, + -ኣ ‘it’, giving -ታ; ለሊሃ ‘herself’)."
- unit 18 · n · minor · -ታ misnamed as the suffix · done: "ርእየታ ‘she saw her’ (perfect + -ታ ‘her’)" → "ርእየታ ‘she saw her’ (3fs perfect ርእየት + -ኣ ‘her’, giving -ታ)"
- unit 18 · n · minor · -ቶ misnamed as the suffix · done: "አእኰተቶ ‘she gave thanks to him’ and ሰብሐቶ ‘she praised him’ (perfect + -ቶ ‘him’)" → "አእኰተቶ ‘she gave thanks to him’ and ሰብሐቶ ‘she praised him’ (3fs perfect + -ኦ ‘him’, giving -ቶ)"
- unit 27 · n · minor · -ቶ misnamed as the suffix · done: "አንገሠቶ ‘she made him king’ (causative አንገሠ of ነግሠ, with -ቶ ‘him’)" → "አንገሠቶ ‘she made him king’ (3fs perfect of the causative አንገሠ of ነግሠ, + -ኦ ‘him’, giving -ቶ)"
- unit 25 · n · moderate · 'before their meeting' is false (they met in Jerusalem long before this point) and 'preparing' is wrong at chapter 85 · done: "The author sets Solomon and Makeda as equals before their meeting, preparing the whole book’s theme of the two kingdoms." → "The author sets Solomon and Makeda side by side as equals, each with a kingdom, recalling the book’s theme of the two kingdoms, Jerusalem and Ethiopia."

## Refused or left (with reason)
- አወፈየቶ / ወአወፈየቶ lemma ወፈየ with 'causative አወፈየ of ወፈየ': possibly shaky, but both stems are plausible and the entries are consistent with the unit notes; with no Dillmann a (?) would add noise without a better reading. Left.
- Causative verbs lemmatized sometimes under the root (ነግሠ, ወፈየ, ሐነጸ) and sometimes under the causative (አምጽአ, አግበረ, አልዐለ): the published parts mix both and the build needs only a lemma before ' — '; not normalized.
- ዐዋዴ (herald) and ዐግያት, ወዲባጋት, ወጋኝተ, ተዓይነ, መጋዝአ, ጐድአ, ጠፍሐ, የበበ: already hedged (?) in the entry and in the notes; no better reading is available without Dillmann. Left.
- ወአዖደት (causative of ዐወደ) and ወአሰርገወት (quadriliteral ሰርገወ): plausible, hedged where doubtful. Left.
- ውስቴታ (-ታ '3fs' on a preposition), ወባቲ and ላቲ: -ቲ/-ታ is the 3fs suffix on prepositions, consistent with the published ላቲ entry. Left.
- ፫፼ወ፳፻ spoken form uses the plural ትእልፊት ('three myriads'), whereas the published ፼ entry gives ትእልፍት for one myriad; both are correct for their numbers. Kept, still marked (?).
- Numeral entries ፹፫–፹፮, ፫፻, ፯፻, ፸ወ፯፻, ወ፸፻ and their arithmetic (32,000; 17,700; 770) re-computed and correct; format matches ch. 82.
- Broaden entries (ወሶበ, ወባቲ, ወለአኩ, እንተ, ነገሥተ): each starts with the known entry whole and adds ' · ' + the new reading; kept. ወለአኩ: the known 1cs reading is doubtful (1cs would be ለአክኩ) but it belongs to a published part and is not ours to change.
- Units: translation, `l`↔`i`, hedging and the arithmetic in the notes re-checked unit by unit; apart from the changes above nothing else found. The remaining uncertain points (ወቄሮም, ደወሎሙ, ፀብኣ, እሊአሃ, ዘበሕጉ, መንግሥታኒ) are all hedged in `i` and note.
